gates.detail: Total tests: 265, Passed: 264, Failed: 1. SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests.WorkerProbeTests.The_worker_serves_its_probes_on_loopback_and_nowhere_else failed with: System.Net.Sockets.SocketException : nodename nor servname provided, or not known, at System.Net.Dns.GetHostEntryOrAddressesCore / System.Net.Dns.GetHostAddresses(Dns.GetHostName()).
